name: suite
description: Records which agent wrote each source file across worktrees, runs the tests beside those writes at every Stop and SubagentStop, and logs who owns each red beside the shell gate's answer, never blocking

sourceRoot.title: Source root
sourceRoot.description: The folder, relative to each tree's root, whose writes are recorded and whose tests run. Empty records writes anywhere in the tree.

testSuffixes.title: Test file suffixes
testSuffixes.description: Space-separated suffixes that mark a test file. A source file's sibling test swaps its extension for the matching suffix, and only files with those extensions are recorded.

runner.title: Test runner command
runner.description: Space-separated command run from the stopping tree's root, the test files appended. Run direct, never through a package manager.

logPath.title: Log path
logPath.description: Where the one line per stop is appended. An absolute path lands as written, a relative one joins the main tree's root.

worktreeDir.title: Worktree folder
worktreeDir.description: The folder, relative to the main tree's root, that holds one subfolder per worktree lane.

runTimeoutSeconds.title: Run ceiling in seconds
runTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a stop waits on the scoped run before logging timeout.

sentinelPrefix.title: Declared-red sentinel prefix
sentinelPrefix.description: Path prefix of the declared-red sentinel, completed by the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the stopping tree's path. Empty reads no sentinel.

sentinelTtlSeconds.title: Sentinel lifetime in seconds
sentinelTtlSeconds.description: A sentinel whose epoch first line is this old or older declares nothing.

gatePhrase.title: Shell gate phrase
gatePhrase.description: The phrase a shell test gate prints when the suite is red, which makes the shell column read suite. Empty reads any block as gate.
